# jido_gralkor v4.1.0 - Table of Contents

> Jido plugin and actions that adapt the Gralkor memory server into a Jido agent. Drop in the plugin for recall-on-query and capture-on-completion; add the actions to your ReAct tools list for explicit memory_search / memory_add.

## Pages

- [jido_gralkor](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/readme.md)

## Modules

- [Gralkor.AgentLearning](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.AgentLearning.md): One flat experiential-learning record: what kind of problem was approached,
the approach taken, whether it succeeded, and the lesson learned.
- [Gralkor.CaptureBuffer](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.CaptureBuffer.md): In-flight conversation buffer keyed by `session_id`.
- [Gralkor.Client](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Client.md): Port for talking to a Gralkor backend from Elixir.
- [Gralkor.Client.InMemory](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Client.InMemory.md): In-memory twin of `Gralkor.Client` for tests.
- [Gralkor.Client.Native](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Client.Native.md): Production `Gralkor.Client` implementation. In-process — no HTTP — talks
to graphiti via `Gralkor.GraphitiPool` (Pythonx-backed) and to the LLM via
`req_llm` (Elixir-side, used by `Gralkor.Distill` and `Gralkor.Interpret`).
- [Gralkor.Config](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Config.md): Configuration for the embedded Gralkor runtime.
- [Gralkor.Distill](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Distill.md): Render a list of conversation turns into the transcript episode body ingested
into the knowledge graph.
- [Gralkor.Format](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Format.md): Format graphiti edge data into the canonical fact strings the LLM sees.
- [Gralkor.Generalisation](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Generalisation.md): Struct and wire format for generalisations stored as graphiti episodes in a
dedicated partition (`"#{group_id}_gen"`).
- [Gralkor.Generalise](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Generalise.md): Orchestrate one generalisation run: hypothesise generalisations from a
transcript, search existing generalisations to rule candidates in or out,
evaluate relationships, and persist the strongest.
- [Gralkor.GraphitiPool](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.GraphitiPool.md): Per-group Graphiti instance cache, plus the gateway for graphiti operations.
- [Gralkor.Interpret](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Interpret.md): Filter retrieved graph facts down to those relevant to the conversation,
using the configured LLM.
- [Gralkor.Learn](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Learn.md): Turn one ERL-marked reasoning turn into a single flat `Gralkor.AgentLearning`
record via one LLM call.
- [Gralkor.LearningEntity](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.LearningEntity.md): The plugin's built-in graphiti custom entity type for ERL.
- [Gralkor.Message](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Message.md): Canonical message shape that Gralkor expects at its port boundary.
- [Gralkor.Ontology](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Ontology.md): Declare an entity-and-relationship ontology for graphiti's custom entity
extraction.
- [Gralkor.Python](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Python.md): PythonX runtime owner for the embedded Gralkor stack.
- [Gralkor.Recall](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.Recall.md): Orchestrate one recall call: search the graph, interpret the hits against
the buffered conversation, wrap the result in a `<gralkor-memory>` block.
- [JidoGralkor.Actions.MemoryAdd](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Actions.MemoryAdd.md): ReAct tool the LLM can call to store a thought or decision in memory.
- [JidoGralkor.Actions.MemoryBuildCommunities](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Actions.MemoryBuildCommunities.md): Admin tool that runs Graphiti's community detection over this agent's
memory partition.
- [JidoGralkor.Actions.MemoryBuildIndices](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Actions.MemoryBuildIndices.md): Admin tool that rebuilds Gralkor's graph search indices.
- [JidoGralkor.Actions.MemorySearch](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Actions.MemorySearch.md): ReAct tool the LLM can call to search long-term memory.
- [JidoGralkor.Canonical](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Canonical.md): Converts a Jido/ReAct turn into Gralkor's canonical message shape.
- [JidoGralkor.ContextRotator](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.ContextRotator.md): Memory consolidation for a long-lived Jido agent.
- [JidoGralkor.Lifecycle](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Lifecycle.md): `Jido.AgentServer.Lifecycle` implementation that flushes the active
Gralkor session when an agent process terminates.
- [JidoGralkor.Plugin](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.Plugin.md): Jido plugin that replaces `Jido.Memory.BasicPlugin` with Gralkor-backed
memory. Claims the `:__memory__` slot so it is the only memory plugin
attached to the agent.
- [JidoGralkor.ReAct](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/JidoGralkor.ReAct.md): Helpers for `Jido.AI.Reasoning.ReAct` consumers that want Gralkor-aware
request shaping.

- Exceptions
  - [Gralkor.GeneralisationParseFailed](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.GeneralisationParseFailed.md): Raised when a string cannot be decoded as a generalisation — the `GEN|v1|`
prefix is missing, the JSON metadata is malformed, or required fields are
absent.
  - [Gralkor.InterpretParseFailed](https://jido-gralkor.hexdocs.pm/Gralkor.InterpretParseFailed.md): Raised when the LLM's interpret response cannot be parsed against the
structured-output schema — typically because `:output_token_budget` was too
small and the model's answer truncated mid-list, but also for any other
schema mismatch.
